links.text:
Today we’re launching Palette!

Built by MIT AI researchers, Palette unifies fragmented creative tools into a single multimodal generation engine.
Now, enterprise teams and content creators can generate, edit, and automate brand-consistent video, ads, and training media entirely through natural language.
Say goodbye to manual, one-off content grinds and hello to scalable media pipelines.

Learn more at http://palettelabs.com and try us out at http://studio.palettelabs.com
